title: Update a score in a map
objective: Change one value in a changing map with set, then read it back with at.

body.text: A map keeps a value for each key. If the map was made changing, you can set the value for one key and leave the others as they are. Read the value back with the map's name, at, and the key.

body.title: Set and read a score
body.code:
make changing scores equal to a map from "Ana" to 3, "Bo" to 5
set scores at "Ana" to 7
make ana equal to scores at "Ana"
say "Ana has {ana}"
say size of scores

body.prompt: The program reports Bo's score as 5, but Bo actually scored 9. Make it print 9.
body.starter:
make changing scores equal to a map from "Ana" to 3, "Bo" to 5
say scores at "Bo"
body.solution:
make changing scores equal to a map from "Ana" to 3, "Bo" to 5
set scores at "Bo" to 9
say scores at "Bo"
